avoid: Uncontrolled collisions while moving in concentric rings
Overly high jumps on slick surfaces
children.game_version: 'Follow the River Fish' game where children in outer and inner rings mimic the movements of a designated lead fish, alternating between swimming twists, gentle hops, and freeze-poses.

avoid: Rapid continuous spins that could compromise balance
seniors.counts: Step smoothly on steady 4-count or 8-count walking phrases.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the concentric dance seated in two nested circles of chairs, executing rhythmic heel-toe taps and fluid upper-torso twists while mirroring hand gestures across the aisle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the circular traveling steps at a slow walking cadence, omitting vertical jumps in favor of gentle knee dips and controlled quarter-turns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce the stepping pace to a comfortable walking tempo and limit torso twists to a moderate, pain-free range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Expressive gestures exchanged between dancers to communicate romantic affection and emotional rapport.
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic stepping sequences interspersed with coordinated jumps and directional turns.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Concentric rings with four men along the outer perimeter and four women within the inner perimeter.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Dynamic twists and rotations designed to imitate the undulating swimming motion of fish in water.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Alternates between upright rhythmic ground steps and vertical jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: Non-contact circular partnering marked by regular eye contact and reciprocal hand gestures across the rings.

signature_moves.description: A fluid twisting motion of the body that mimics the undulating navigation of fish in water.
signature_moves.name: Fish mimicry twist

signature_moves.description: A leaping rotation executed while maintaining spatial placement in the nested circular formation.
signature_moves.name: Concentric jump turn

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking eye contact with partners or drifting out of concentric alignment between the inner and outer rings.

music_profile.sound_description: The sonic texture is characterized by driving drum patterns intertwined with continuous shaken rattle pulses and melodic flute interludes. Over this percussive tapestry, vocalists deliver celebratory love songs dedicated to the couple, creating a bright, uplifting atmosphere appropriate for marital rites.
music_profile.vocal_style: Love songs praising the bride and groom

basic_steps: Inner-outer circle formation setup: four women form the center circle facing outward, four men form an exterior concentric ring facing inward.
Rhythmic forward traveling step maintaining the circular trajectory around the space.
Aquatic torso twist: rotating the upper body from side to side to simulate swimming motions.
Elevation jump: executing small vertical jumps accented by percussive drum hits.
Turn and focus: performing a sharp pivot or full spin while re-establishing direct eye contact with the dancing partner.
teaching.formation: Concentric circles with four men moving on the outside and four women on the inside.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must coordinate the circular pathway while sustaining active eye contact and mirroring partner turns across the inner and outer rings.
